about.heading: About
about.summary: I'm a roboticist who enjoys turning ideas into clean, working systems — from embedded control software to the interfaces built on top of them.

projects.name: VISION-Inspect
projects.description: Autonomous visual inspection of infrastructure with a quadruped robot — navigating to sites like culverts and drainage structures with an onboard sensor payload, validated against an RTK/GPS reference station for ground-truth positioning.

projects.name: fly-mhw
projects.description: Teaching a fruit-fly brain connectome to hunt in Monster Hunter World. A recurrent network built on the real Janelia MaleCNS wiring (topology and synapse sign fixed, only a small trainable surface of gains/biases/encoder/readout ever trained) drives a real game through reverse-engineered memory reads and a virtual gamepad — bootstrapped via imitation learning from recorded hunts, with RL fine-tuning next.
